tasks.analysis: Maps are tools that help us understand the world around us. They show the locations of places like cities , rivers, and mountains. These visual guides can also display different types of information, such as climate or population. There are many kinds, including physical, political, and thematic versions. The study of maps and cartography, the process by which they are made, can teach us about the geography of our planet and how people live in different regions. 地图是帮助我们了解周围世界的工具。它们展示出城市、河流和山脉等地方的位置。这些视觉指南还能呈现不同类型的信息，比如气候或人口情况。地图的种类繁多，其中包括自然地图、政区地图和专题地图。对地图以及地图绘制（即制作地图的过程）的研究，能够让我们了解地球的地理状况以及不同地区人们的生活方式。
